title: Recaps
summary: Weekly and monthly reviews of how a period went, against the one before.

requirements.text: A recap covers a calendar week (Monday to Sunday) or a calendar month.
A recap compares its period with the one before it.
A period still in progress is compared with the same number of days of the period before.
Recaps are computed from the diary on demand; only the latest finished week and month seen are stored.

history.text: Recaps are computed from the diary on demand; only which finished recaps were seen is stored.
history.reason: Version 1 implied a record per recap seen; a single high-water mark per kind is stored.
